blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recently, video world models have advanced interactive generation, with large models offering higher quality and smaller models enabling faster inference. Existing speculative methods combine their strengths through fast draft generation and selective target regeneration guided by rewards on decoded frames. However, verification covers only the external scorer's evaluation dimensions and adds decoding and scoring costs. Moreover, these scores provide no correction, requiring costly target regeneration for rejected drafts. To address these limitations, we propose Speculative World Model (SpecWM), a unified, training-free inference framework for streaming world models. It verifies draft chunks using the target's latent velocity field. Verification also yields a reusable correction; two thresholds select Accept, Refine, or Reject. Specifically, one-step refinement reuses it to improve perceptual quality, while three-step refinement strengthens camera following and trajectory consistency. These findings motivate transition-aware refinement. On WBench Navigation, SpecWM improves visual quality at 1.63$\times$ speedup over the target and raises NavScore from the draft's 75.99 to 85.63, achieving the best quality-speed-control trade-off. Additionally, our LongSpecBench shows sustained quality and control over long, multi-turn rollouts, while experiments on Hy-Nomas validate SpecWM across backbones and denoising budgets.
blocks.zh: 最近,视频世界模型已经先进的交互生成,大型模型提供了更高的质量,较小的模型能够更快的推论. 现有的投机方法通过快速的草稿生成和有选择的目标再生,在解码框上的奖励指导下,将其优点结合起来。 然而,核查只涵盖外部计分员的评价层面,并增加了解码和计分费用. 此外,这些评分不作任何更正,需要为被拒绝的草稿提供昂贵的目标再生。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议采用光谱世界模型(SpecWM),作为流派世界模型的统一、无培训的推论框架。 它利用目标的潜在速度场验证草稿块。 核查还产生可重复使用的更正;选择两个阈值:接受、完善或拒绝。 具体地说,单步改进可以再利用它来提高知觉质量,而三步改进可以加强相机跟随和轨迹一致性. 这些调查结果促使人们认识到过渡性的改进。 在WBench导航上,SpecWM将视觉质量提升到1.63美元\时速超过目标,并将NavScore从草稿的75.99提高到85.63,实现最佳质量-速度-控制比对. 此外,我们的LongSpec Bench显示出对长期、多回合推出的持续质量和控制,而Hy-Normas的实验验证了SpecWM跨骨干和取消预算。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Streaming world models enable users to explore generated environments that evolve in response to their actions [ 11 , 17 ] . Such interaction requires high visual quality, accurate control following, and rapid responses to changing inputs. However, larger models offer stronger quality and control at substantial computational cost, whereas smaller models generate faster at the expense of visual quality and accuracy in following the controls (Fig. 1 , right).
blocks.zh: 流转的世界模型使用户能够探索因应其行动而演变的生成环境[11,17]. 这种互动需要高视觉质量、准确的跟踪控制以及对不断变化的投入作出快速反应。 然而,较大的模型以高昂的计算成本提供更强的质量和控制,而较小的模型在遵循控制时以牺牲视觉质量和准确性为代价生成更快(图1,右侧)。

blocks.en: Existing reward-based speculative methods combine these strengths through fast draft generation and selective target regeneration. Rewards computed on decoded draft frames determine which chunks to accept and which to regenerate with the target. Setting up this verifier requires choosing a reward model, aggregating frame scores, and calibrating an acceptance threshold [ 16 ] . However, verification is limited to the attributes captured by the external scorer [ 44 ] . Decoding and scoring also add runtime costs per chunk. Moreover, these scores provide no direct refinement signal to improve the draft itself (Fig. 1 , left). Consequently, every rejected draft requires computationally expensive regeneration by the target through its full sampling process, reducing the savings from fast draft generation. How can verification itself provide a reusable correction to improve the trade-off among speed, visual quality, and control in speculative generation for streaming world models?
blocks.zh: 现有的基于奖励的投机方法,通过快速的草稿生成和选择性的目标再生,将这些优点结合起来。 根据解码框架草案计算出的奖励决定哪些块可以接受,哪些块可以与目标重生. 设立这个核查员需要选择奖励模式,汇总帧分数,并校准接受阈值[16]. 然而,核查仅限于外部计分员捕获的属性[44]. 解码和评分还增加了每个块的运行时间成本. 此外,这些分数没有为改进草案本身提供直接的完善信号(图1,左)。 因此,每个被否决的草稿都需要目标通过充分取样过程进行计算费用昂贵的再生,从而减少快速的草稿生成带来的节余。 核查本身如何提供可重复使用的校正,以改进速度、视觉质量和对流世界模型投机生成的控制之间的权衡?

blocks.en: We propose Speculative World Model (SpecWM) , a unified, training-free inference framework that turns verification into refinement for streaming autoregressive (AR) world models. SpecWM replaces decoded-frame reward scoring with a single final-stage evaluation of the target’s latent velocity field v v . This evaluation yields a clean prediction under the same history and controls. Its difference from the draft provides a verification score. Moreover, the same prediction supplies a reusable correction. Based on this score, SpecWM uses two thresholds to select Accept, Refine, or Reject to allocate target computation across chunks.
blocks.zh: 我们提出 " 光谱世界模型 " (SpecWM),这是一个统一、无培训的推论框架,将核查转化为对流式自转世界模型的完善。 SpecWM用对目标潜在速度场 v v 的单一最后阶段评价取代解码框奖励评分. 这一评价在相同的历史和控制下得出了干净的预测。 它与草案的区别提供了核查分数。 此外,同样的预测提供了可重复使用的更正。 基于这一分数,SpecWM使用两个阈值来选择Accept,Final,或拒绝来分配目标计算跨块.

blocks.en: One-step refinement directly reuses the prediction from verification, without further target denoising. Three-step refinement starts at a higher noise level and runs three consecutive target denoising steps. With verification fixed, our uniform-refinement experiments reveal complementary effects (Table 1 ). One-step refinement improves imaging quality and perceptual preference over the draft, with limited improvement in navigation control. Three-step refinement strengthens camera following and trajectory consistency, but lowers perceptual preference and aesthetics relative to one step; imaging quality remains similar. Image diffusion studies link early denoising to coarse structure and later steps to fine detail [ 48 ] . Our results suggest a similar distinction: final-stage correction improves appearance, while earlier intervention allows greater trajectory revision.
blocks.zh: 一步一步的改进直接重复核查的预测,而不再去名。 三步完善从更高的噪声水平开始,并连续运行三个目标调试步骤. 随着核查的固定,我们的统一精炼实验揭示了互补效应(表1)。 单步完善可提高成像质量和观念偏好于草稿,导航控制改进有限. 三步改进可以加强相机跟随和轨迹一致性,但比一步降低知觉偏好和美学;成像质量仍然相似. 图像传播研究将早期的去Noing与粗结构联系起来,以后的步骤细化[48]. 我们的结果表明类似的区别:最后阶段的校正改善了外观,而早期的干预则允许更大的轨迹修正。

blocks.en: These findings motivate transition-aware refinement . For chunks routed to Refine, SpecWM uses three steps at a control change, two in the next chunk, and one thereafter. This schedule improves control near transitions while favoring perceptual quality and speed during continued motion. Throughout this schedule, verification remains fixed at one final-stage probe per draft chunk. Additionally, the draft generates the next chunk while the target verifies the current one, thereby reducing latency.
blocks.zh: 这些结论促使人们认识到过渡的改进。 对于路由至Final的块,SpecWM在控制变化时使用三个步骤,在下一个块中使用两个步骤,然后使用一个步骤。 该时间表改进了接近过渡的控制,同时有利于在继续运动期间的感知质量和速度. 在整个时间表中,核查工作一直固定在每块一个最后阶段的探测器上。 此外,草案产生下一个块,而目标则核查目前的块,从而减少延迟。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • SpecWM. We propose a unified, training-free framework that turns verification into refinement. With transition-aware refinement, SpecWM achieves a 1.63 × \times generation-loop speedup over Target-only on WBench Navigation [ 51 ] , improving imaging quality and perceptual preference while maintaining target-level navigation control. • LongSpecBench. We construct a benchmark of long, multi-turn rollouts with revisits to jointly evaluate generation quality, speed, and sustained controllability. SpecWM leads the evaluated methods in world-model quality (WMQ) and quality-efficiency score (QES). • Beyond model scale. SpecWM extends from model-scale to denoising-budget differences on Hy-Nomas [ 7 ] , where draft and target share the same weights. It outperforms Draft-only and SDVG-style across four human-evaluated dimensions, achieving near-target preference at a 1.33 × \times generation-loop speedup over Target-only.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们建议建立一个统一、无培训的框架,将核查转化为完善。 随着过渡意识的完善,SpecWM在WBench导航[51]上实现了1.63×\time生成-loop的加速速度,提高了成像质量和知觉偏好,同时保持目标级别的导航控制. • LongSpec Bench。 我们构建了一个长期、多回合推出的基准,重新审视,共同评价发电质量、速度和持续可控性。 SpecWM在世界模型质量(WMQ)和质量效率分数(QES)中领先评价的方法. • 超越模型规模。 SpecWM在Hy-Normas[7]上从模型尺度延伸至去Noising-预算差异,其中草案和目标共享相同的权重. 它超越了Draft-Only和SDVG风格,跨越了人类评价的四个维度,在1.33 × \times生成-loop速度上达到接近目标偏好,而不是目标偏快.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Autoregressive video generation and world models. Diffusion models [ 14 ] , latent representations [ 37 ] , and transformers [ 36 ] underpin video synthesis [ 15 , 1 , 6 , 47 , 12 ] . Building on this foundation, camera and motion conditioning enable controllable generation [ 13 , 43 ] , while flexible temporal conditioning incorporates generation history [ 4 , 41 ] . For streaming generation, causal distillation reduces latency [ 50 , 52 ] , and training on self-generated histories addresses the training-inference mismatch [ 18 ] . Longer rollouts further require managing accumulated errors through long-video tuning, cache refreshes, and rolling denoising [ 46 , 26 ] . These developments support interactive world models that respond to user actions [ 2 , 11 , 17 , 7 ] . Evaluation likewise extends from video quality in VBench [ 19 ] to multi-turn interaction in WBench [ 51 ] . SpecWM addresses computation allocation during streaming inference to balance visual quality, speed, and control.
blocks.zh: 自动回归视频生成与世界模式. 扩散模型[14],潜在表示[37],变压器[36]支撑视频合成[15,1,6,47,12]. 在这个基础上,相机和运动调节使可控生成[13,43]成为可能,而灵活的时间调节则包含生成历史[4,41]. 对于流体生成,因果蒸馏可以减少耐久性[50,52],关于自产生历史的培训可以解决训练-推论不匹配[18]. 更长时间的推出进一步要求通过长视频调制,缓存刷新,以及滚动调制[46,26]管理累积错误. 这些动态支持响应用户行动的交互式世界模式[2,11,17,7]. 同样,评价从V Bench [19] 的视频质量延伸到W Bench的多回合互动[51]。 SpecWM在流推时处理计算分配,以平衡视觉质量,速度,和控制.

blocks.en: Caching and efficient inference. Efficient samplers [ 40 , 28 ] , distillation [ 38 , 49 ] , and consistency models [ 42 ] reduce denoising steps. Beyond reducing steps, caching exploits redundancy in features, attention, and guidance [ 30 , 29 ] . Adaptive reuse responds to estimated output changes or chunk-level variation [ 25 , 31 ] . For world models, selective token recomputation [ 10 ] and history-guided caching with residual correction [ 35 ] address reuse across evolving content. System optimizations combine caching with sparse attention, quantization, and kernel fusion [ 21 ] . These approaches lower the cost of running a generator by reusing internal computations or reducing sampling steps. SpecWM instead allocates computation according to the draft chunk’s discrepancy from the target. Accept, Refine, and Reject provide different levels of target intervention. This allocation applies to pairings with different model scales or denoising budgets, including shared-weight configurations.
blocks.zh: 缓冲和高效的推论。 高效的采样器[40,28],蒸馏[38,49],以及一致性模型[42]减少调试步骤. 除了减少步骤外,缓存还利用了特征、注意力和引导方面的冗余性[30、29]。 适应性再利用对估计产出变化或块级变化作出反应[25、31]。 对于世界模型,有选择的代号重算[10]和历史制导的带有剩余校正的缓存[35]解决了不断变化的内容的再利用问题。 系统优化结合了缓存与稀疏的注意力,量子化,以及内核聚变[21]. 这些方法通过重新使用内部计算或减少采样步骤来降低运行生成器的成本. SpecWM 则根据草稿块与目标的差异来分配计算 。 接受、完善和拒绝提供不同程度的目标干预。 这一分配适用于具有不同模型尺度或取消命名预算的配对,包括共享加权配置.

blocks.en: Speculative verification and refinement. Speculative decoding combines draft proposals with target verification [ 20 , 5 ] ; feature prediction and multiple decoding heads improve proposal generation [ 22 , 3 ] . DSpark uses confidence and serving load to schedule token verification [ 8 ] . In video generation, SDVG uses ImageReward [ 44 ] on decoded draft frames to select acceptance or target regeneration [ 16 ] . However, this verifier incurs decoding and scoring costs, and its coverage depends on the external scorer. Moreover, the scores guide selection without supplying a direct correction. Separately, other methods allocate computation within one generator: Speculative Forcing freezes converged tokens [ 9 ] , while Surprise Forcing skips steps according to chunk difficulty [ 39 ] . SpecWM instead verifies draft chunks using the target’s latent velocity prediction. The resulting clean estimate can correct the draft, adding refinement between acceptance and full regeneration.
blocks.zh: 投机性核查与完善. 光谱解码将提案草案与目标核查[20,5]结合起来;特征预测和多个解码头改进了提案生成[22,3]. DSpark 使用置信性和服务载荷来排程符号验证 [8]. 在视频生成中,SDVG在解码的草稿帧上使用Image Reward [44]来选择接受或目标再生[16]. 然而,这个核查员要承担解码和评分费用,其覆盖范围取决于外部评分员. 此外,评分指导选择,没有提供直接更正。 另外,其他方法在一个生成器内分配计算: Speculative Forcing storing commonds orders [9],而"惊喜 Forcing"则根据块难度跳过步骤 [39]. SpecWM用目标的潜在速度预测来验证草稿块。 由此得出的清洁估计可以校正草案,在接受和完全再生之间增加了完善.

blocks.en: Once a chunk is routed to Refine, the remaining choice is its correction length. Our uniform-refinement study reveals complementary effects (Table 1 ). One-step correction improves perceptual quality over the draft. Three-step correction improves camera following and trajectory consistency, but lowers perceptual preference and aesthetics relative to one step. We therefore allocate longer corrections near control transitions and shorter corrections during continued motion, with verification fixed.

blocks.en: Quality-speed-control trade-off. SpecWM achieves the best overall quality-speed-control trade-off among the evaluated methods (Table 1 , Fig. 4 ). At 1.63 × \times speedup over Target-only, it retains comparable NavScore (85.63 versus 85.49) and improves HPSv3 from 74.57 to 77.66. It also gains 9.64 NavScore points over Draft-only. Our selective target intervention thus recovers target-level control with lower latency and higher perceptual preference.
blocks.zh: 质量-速度控制权衡. SpecWM在评估方法之间实现了最佳的整体质量-速度控制权衡(表1,图4)。 在1.63×\时速高于目标-时速,它保留了可比的NavScore(85.63对85.49),并将HPSv3从74.57改进为77.66. 它还比Draft获得9.64 NavScore积分. 因此,我们的选择性目标干预恢复了目标一级的控制,其延迟度较低,观念偏好更高。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : WBench quality-speed-control comparison. Top: Imaging versus NavScore; dotted arrows indicate increasing refinement length within each policy family. Bottom: generation-loop speedup over Target-only. Longer fixed refinements improve navigation but reduce speed. In comparison, SpecWM achieves the highest Imaging and NavScore at 1.63 × \times speedup (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 图4:W Bench质量-速度控制比较. 顶部 : 成像与NavScore;点箭表示每个政策家族内不断完善的长度. 底部: 生成- 启动速度 超过目标 - 仅限目标 。 较长的固定精度改进改进了导航但降低了速度. 相比之下,SpecWM以1.63×\times的加速(表1)实现了最高的成像和NavScore.

blocks.en: Effects of refinement length. Longer refinement favors control over perceptual preference. Increasing Refine-all from one to three steps raises NavScore from 75.92 to 85.17, but lowers HPSv3 from 77.80 to 74.26 and speedup from 1.78 × \times to 1.10 × \times . Imaging quality remains similar. These complementary effects motivate allocating correction length around transitions. By selecting where and how long to refine, SpecWM therefore approaches both one-step perceptual preference and target-level control, while maintaining lower latency than uniform three-step correction.
blocks.zh: 完善长度的影响。 更长时间的完善有利于控制观念偏好. 将全程从1级提升到3级,将NavScore从75.92级提升到85.17级,但将HPSv3从77.80级降低到74.26级,将速度从1.78 ×\时速提高到1.10 ×\时速. 图像质量仍然类似。 这些补充效应促使将校正长度围绕过渡进行分配。 因此,SpecWM通过选择精炼地点和精炼时间,既采用单步感知偏好,又采用目标水平控制,同时保持低于统一三步校正的延迟.

blocks.en: Refinement reduces regeneration. Equal acceptance rates need not yield equal efficiency. Both SDVG-style and SpecWM accept 68% of chunks, but SpecWM refines 13%, leaving 19% for full target generation, including fallback, versus 32% for SDVG-style. Refinement therefore reduces the share requiring a full target run. Together with latent verification and overlapped execution, SpecWM raises speedup from 1.42 × \times to 1.63 × \times while improving visual quality and control. Fig. 5 illustrates its preservation of scene structure and response to changing controls in both cases.
blocks.zh: 完善减少再生. 同等接受率不需要产生同等的效率。 SDVG风格和SpecWM都接受68%的块,但SpecWM精细化了13%,剩下19%用于包括倒置在内的全目标生成,而SDVG风格则为32%. 因此,完善可减少需要全部目标运行的份额。 与潜在验证和重叠执行一起,SpecWM将速度从1.42××时提高到1.63×时,同时提高视觉质量和控制. 图5说明了对现场结构的维护,以及对两个案件不断变化的控制的反应。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Qualitative comparison under changing controls. Target-only, Draft-only, SDVG-style, and SpecWM share the inputs and control sequence in each case. Control inputs are shown below the frames. Highlighted regions mark control failures and geometry collapse. SpecWM follows the changing controls while preserving scene structure across both sequences.
blocks.zh: 图5:不断变化的控制下的质量比较。 仅针对目标,只针对草稿,SDVG风格,SpecWM在每种情况下共享输入和控制序列. 控制输入在框架下面。 突出区域标志着控制故障和几何崩溃. SpecWM跟随不断变化的控件,同时保留两个序列的场景结构.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Studies and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 研究与分析

blocks.zh: 表2隔离了在同一最后阶段核查下的精细化、路由和执行工作。

Random routing matches route shares; synchronous execution disables draft-target overlap while retaining the full policy. Bold / underline marks the best/second-best value per column.

blocks.en: Probe selection. In a five-chunk pilot from one video, final-stage discrepancies span 0.1738–0.2698, a max/min ratio of 1.55 versus 1.22 and 1.30 at the first two stages. Separate optimized timings give 1.5 s for one stage versus 4.4 s for four-stage verification. The observed score variation, lower cost, and reusable candidate together motivate our choice of the final-stage probe.
blocks.zh: 探析选. 在一次录像的五缸飞行员中,最后阶段的差异跨度为0.1738-0.2698,最大比为1.55比1.22,前两个阶段为1.30。 单阶段优化时间给出1.5s,四阶段核查给出4.4s. 观测到的分数变化, 成本降低, 和可重复使用的候选人 共同激励我们选择 最后阶段的探测。

blocks.en: Refinement schedule. The full schedule raises NavScore from fixed one-step refinement’s 76.39 to 85.63. Removing the intermediate two-step correction lowers it to 81.49 and spatial consistency from 80.83 to 76.90, for only a small speedup increase (1.63 × \times to 1.67 × \times ). Thus, continued correction supports control and consistency after transitions.
blocks.zh: 完善时间表. 整个时间表将NavScore从固定的一步改进的76.39提高到85.63。 移除中间的两步校正将其降低到81.49,空间一致性从80.83降至76.90,因为只有小的加速度(1.63 ×\时为1.67 ×\时为). 因此,持续的校正支持过渡后的控制和一致性。

blocks.en: Score-guided routing. Removing Refine lowers speedup to 1.21 × \times and NavScore to 82.18; removing Reject raises speedup to 2.07 × \times but lowers NavScore to 80.46. Thus, refinement reduces reliance on full regeneration, while retaining regeneration improves control. Moreover, random routing with matched shares gives 0.95 × \times speedup and NavScore 75.98. Effective allocation depends on which chunks receive each action, not only on overall route shares.
blocks.zh: 分数导行. 删除 Final 将速度降低到 1. 21 ×\times 和 NavScore 降低到 82. 18; 删除 NavScore 将速度提升到 2.07 ×\times 但将 NavScore 降低到 80.46 。 因此,完善可减少对全面再生的依赖,同时保留再生可改善控制。 此外,配对股的随机路由给出了0.95×\时速加速和NavScore 75.98. 有效的分配取决于每个动作接收的块,而不仅仅取决于总的路由份额.

blocks.en: Fallback and overlapped execution. Removing fallback or overlap lowers speedup from 1.63 × \times to 1.45 × \times or 1.29 × \times , respectively. Fallback skips repeated draft and probe costs during consecutive target generation, while overlap prepares the next draft during verification (Fig. 3 ). These gains persist with state restoration and re-proposal costs included, linking computation savings to lower generation latency.
blocks.zh: 后退与重叠执行. 删除倒数或重叠将速度分别从1.63 ×\时降至1.45 ×时或1.29 ×\时。 Fallback在连续的目标生成过程中跳过重复的草稿和探测费用,而重叠则在核查过程中准备下一份草稿(图3). 这些收益继续存在,包括国家恢复和重新提议费用,将计算节省与较低代的延迟挂钩。

blocks.en: 5.4 LongSpecBench: Long-Horizon Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.4 朗斯佩克奔驰: 长视距评价

blocks.en: Benchmark design. We construct LongSpecBench to test sustained control and scene persistence over long rollouts with repeated turns and revisits. Its 100 initial scenes come from WBench [ 51 ] (30), WorldMark [ 45 ] (30), and TrajectoryBench [ 33 ] (40). The first 20 cases set τ = 0.2395 \tau=0.2395 and τ r = 0.2716 \tau_{r}=0.2716 using the same 70th/90th-percentile rule; the remaining 80 form the evaluation split. Each rollout contains ten to twelve action turns and revisits over 509 frames at 16 fps (about 32 seconds, 32 chunks), with the same input-dependent resolution as WBench.
blocks.zh: 基准设计。 我们建造了LongSpec Bench,以测试持续控制和场景的持久性,在长期展开时,反复转弯和重新审视。 它的100个初始场景来自WBench [51](30),WorldMark [45](30),以及Traprextory Bench [33](40). 前20个案例设置=0.2395\tau=0.2395和r=0.2716\tau\r\0.2716 采用相同的第70/90百分率规则;其余80个构成评分. 每次推出包含10到12个动作转弯,并在16 fps(约32秒,32块)重温超过509帧,与W Bench具有相同的输入依赖分辨率.

blocks.en: Evaluation dimensions. Seven metrics measure visual quality (Imaging, Aesth.), temporal and revisit consistency (Long-T., Revisit), and control through motion direction (Dir.), response to changes (Resp.), and camera following (Cam.). Cam. scores trajectory following on [ 0,100 ] [0,100] using poses estimated by MegaSaM [ 23 ] .

blocks.en: Long-horizon results. SpecWM preserves near-target revisit consistency (76.56 versus 76.77) at 1.67 × \times speedup, while leading all three control metrics (Table 3 ). It closes most of the draft’s revisit gap, from 66.40 to 76.56. These results extend the shorter-rollout findings: selective correction sustains control and scene persistence through repeated turns and returns. Its leading WMQ (72.41) and QES (70.32) summarize this quality-efficiency trade-off.
blocks.zh: 长征结果. SpecWM在1.67×\时速加速时保持了近目标重访一致性(76.56对76.77),同时领先于所有三种控制度量衡(表3). 它弥补了草案的大部分重审空白,从66.40到76.56。 这些结果延长了较短的滚动结果:选择性的校正通过反复转弯和返回来维持控制和场景的持久性. 它领先的WMQ(72.41)和QES(70.32)总结了这种质量效率的权衡.

blocks.en: 5.5 Pairing by Denoising Budget
blocks.zh: 5.5 预算对等

blocks.en: Shared-weight pairing. We evaluate Hy-Nomas [ 7 ] with the same distilled 8B weights, using four sampling steps for the draft and eight for the target. A fixed terminal probe provides a score and correction, while transition-aware refinement selects correction intervals on the native grid. Pairwise human evaluation uses the official 280-case Hy-Nomas-Bench; other settings follow native defaults. Sampling and evaluation details appear in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 共享重量配对. 我们用同样的蒸馏8B重量来评价Hy-Normas [7],利用4个取样步骤对草案和8个目标进行取样。 固定的终端探测器提供分数和校正,而过渡感知的精炼则在本土网格上选择校正间隔. Pairwise 人类评价使用正式的280 case Hy-Normas-Bench;其他设置遵循本土默认. 取样和评价细节见补充材料。

blocks.en: Human preference and efficiency. SpecWM achieves near-target human preference at 1.33 × \times generation-loop speedup (Fig. 6 ). Against Target-only, ties dominate each dimension, with comparable win and loss rates. SpecWM also records positive win-loss margins against Draft-only and SDVG-style across all four dimensions. Compared with SDVG-style, higher preference in camera control and spatial memory accompanies faster generation. Together, relative preference scores and speedups summarize SpecWM’s balance between human preference and efficiency.
blocks.zh: 人类的偏好和效率。 SpecWM在1.33×\times生成-loop加速(图6)时实现近目标人类偏好. 仅针对目标,联系在每一方面占据主导地位,得失率相当。 SpecWM还记录了在所有四个维度上对Draw Only和SDVG风格的正面双损幅度. 与SDVG风格相比,相机控制和空间内存伴有更高的偏好能更快的生成. 相对偏好分数和速度加起来,总结了SpecWM在人类偏好和效率之间的平衡.

blocks.en: Across backbones and sampling budgets. Together with LingBot, these results validate SpecWM across backbones and pairing strategies. Specifically, LingBot uses different model scales, whereas Hy-Nomas varies the sampling budget within one network. Finer denoising steps provide corrections without increasing model capacity. SpecWM accelerates generation even with identical model weights. Native sampling budgets offer another way to form draft-target pairs without training a separate draft model.
blocks.zh: 贯穿骨干和抽样预算。 这些结果与LingBot一起验证了SpecWM跨骨干和配对策略. 具体来说,小玲 瓶体使用不同的模型尺度,而Hy-Nomas则在一个网络内改变采样预算. 更精细的点名步骤在不增加模型能力的情况下提供矫正。 SpecWM加速生成,即使具有相同的模型重量. 本地采样预算提供了另一种方式,在不培训单独模式草案的情况下形成草案-目标对。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present SpecWM, a unified, training-free inference framework that turns verification into refinement for streaming world models. The target’s latent velocity prediction supplies both a verification signal and a reusable correction, reducing reliance on costly regeneration. Our experiments reveal complementary benefits of short and long refinements for perceptual quality and trajectory control. Transition-aware refinement combines these benefits, achieving the best overall quality-speed-control trade-off among the evaluated methods on WBench Navigation and our LongSpecBench. Hy-Nomas further demonstrates effective pairing through different denoising budgets with shared weights. Together, these findings support verification-guided refinement across model-scale and sampling-budget differences. Future work will extend draft-target pairing through cross-model latent alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们提出SpecWM,这是一个统一的、没有训练的推论框架,将核查转化为对流世界模型的完善。 目标的潜在速度预测既提供核查信号,又提供可重复使用的校正,从而减少对昂贵再生的依赖。 我们的实验揭示了短而长的改进对视觉质量和轨迹控制的补充性好处。 过渡意识的完善结合了这些好处,实现了WBench导航和LongSpec Bench上评估方法之间最佳的总体质量-速度控制权衡。 Hy-Nomas进一步证明,通过不同的去诺化预算与共享权重有效配对. 这些调查结果共同支持在核查指导下改进模型规模和抽样预算之间的差异。 今后的工作将通过跨模式的潜在对接,扩大草案目标配对。
